label: Stormtrooper
description: Follows orders, misses every shot, and is fairly sure this is the route you're looking for.
direction: Speak in a clipped, flat, military radio voice, as if through a helmet: brisk, dutiful, slightly bored, an ordinary soldier on patrol. Keep the direction word crisp.
notes: A rank-and-file trooper rather than any named one. The helmet filter is left to the voice model; nothing in the text asks for it. The voice model is not chosen yet, so `voice` is the placeholder TBD.

rights.author: Lucasfilm (created by George Lucas)
rights.pd_basis: None. Lucasfilm, now Disney, holds copyright and trademark in the character. The troopers were voiced by many performers across the films, none of whom has licensed anything here.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Hold this course.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Stay on target.
lines.start_drive_2: This is the route you're looking for.
lines.start_drive_3: Trooper reporting for duty. Let's move out.
lines.start_drive_4: Squad, form up. We are rolling out.
lines.start_drive_5: Let me see your identification. Fine. You can go about your business.
lines.start_drive_7: For the Empire! Also, I can't see a thing in this helmet.
lines.start_drive_8: Set for stun and buckle up. Here we go.
lines.start_drive_9: Lord Vader wants us on time. No pressure.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. We missed. We always miss.
lines.arrived: We have arrived. You can go about your business.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Move along.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Copy that.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Is this a trap?
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Hold your position, trooper.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Not our fault this time, sir.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Look sharp, and mind your head.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. It never misses. Unlike us.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Halt! Stop right there.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Local patrol. Everybody act natural.
lines.reroute_chime: Missed it. Naturally. Plotting a new course.
